title: PinningApiKey::resolve() is the right pattern for secretx-capable config types
description: PinningApiKey owns its own secretx resolution via a resolve(self, label) method rather than having main.rs inline the secretx API. This is the correct design: the type knows its own encoding (UTF-8 string), provides a single place to change resolution behavior, and the Debug/Display redaction works correctly throughout. A future contributor might suggest moving resolution to main.rs for consistency with other fields — resist this: the type-method approach is better and should be extended to other secretx-capable types when they graduate from simple string to domain types.
